documents.title: Port Authority of Thailand announcement: special fuel-oil-usage surcharge for container service at Bangkok Port and Laem Chabang Port (ประกาศการท่าเรือแห่งประเทศไทย ลงวันที่ 20 มีนาคม 2569)

publisher_authority.reviewer_record: beer598623 (audit identity only -- no external contact; WO-050 / Issue #94)
publisher_authority.basis: PAT is the statutory port authority operating Bangkok Port and Laem Chabang Port under the Port Authority of Thailand Act B.E. 2494 (1951); this notice itself states its legal basis as Articles 4 and 13 of the PAT Regulation on the Use of Port Services and Facilities B.E. 2544 (2001), issued under that Act, under which PAT sets service/facility usage fees at these two ports. Scope is deliberately limited to tariff_or_fee matters at these two named ports; this document does not establish PAT authority over berth availability, schedules, capacity, customs, hazard or any other operational matter at these ports.

known_limitations: Automated retrieval of canonical_url was attempted at Work Order start (WebFetch) and failed with EGRESS_BLOCKED -- a categorical domain block from this environment's network egress proxy, not a TLS/auth failure -- consistent with every other external domain tried on this project (docs/known_data_gaps.md). Per WO-050/Issue #94, retrieval stopped there; this notice's content was instead supplied directly by a human as an already-read transcript of the official Royal Gazette PDF (Volume 143, Special Section 98 Ngo, page 19). retrieval_status is 'not_applicable' per the existing MANUAL_NOTICE_INTAKE convention.

This notice carries three distinct, independently meaningful dates: the notice's own signing/announcement date (20 March 2026, stated in the notice as 'ประกาศ ณ วันที่ 20 มีนาคม 2569'), the Royal Gazette publication date (16 April 2026, used here as published_at), and the date a human observed this specific PAT website posting of the notice (20 April 2026, embedded in canonical_url's own path segment). None should be conflated with another; only the Royal Gazette date is recorded in the published_at field.

Article 3 of this notice commits PAT to reviewing this rate on 1 January, 1 April, 1 July and 1 October of every year against a PTT diesel-price formula, adjusting only when the computed change exceeds 5%. The 1 July 2026 review point has already passed as of this record's review date (2026-08-10) with an unknown outcome. This Document and its Claims establish only what PAT announced effective 1 April 2026 -- not whether that rate is still in effect today. Current validity / supersession-since-this-notice is recorded as unknown and was not further investigated (one-notice-only Work Order scope).

This is purely a tariff/fee-rate notice. It states nothing about port congestion, vessel delay, berth or capacity availability, service disruption, or wider Thailand/regional ocean-freight conditions; none of those is inferred here.
Only a bounded factual paraphrase and the specific figures in Article 2's rate table are retained; the notice's full text has never been stored in this repository (stored_content: 'none').
